Container.Name: immich-machine-learning-openvino
Container.Overview: Immich Machine Learning service with Intel OpenVINO GPU acceleration. Uses Intel iGPU (UHD/Iris Graphics) for ML inference. Works with Intel N100, N150, NUC, and other chips with integrated graphics. Handles face recognition, CLIP-based image search, and OCR using GPU-accelerated inference. Must be on the same Docker network as the Immich server.
Container.Requires: Requires Intel iGPU with /dev/dri available. Must be on the same Docker network as the immich-server container. Full setup guide: https://rorar.github.io/immich-unraid-manual/

Config.Name: Device: Intel iGPU
Config.Description: Intel integrated GPU device. Required for OpenVINO acceleration.

Config.Name: Path: USB Bus
Config.Description: USB device bus. Required for Intel Neural Compute Stick or VPU devices. Can be removed if using only iGPU.

Config.Name: Path: Model Cache
Config.Description: ML model cache directory. Models are downloaded on first use (several GB).

Config.Name: MACHINE_LEARNING_MODEL_TTL
Config.Description: Seconds of inactivity before unloading models from memory. Set to 0 to keep loaded permanently.

Config.Name: MACHINE_LEARNING_WORKERS
Config.Description: Number of ML worker processes. For multi-GPU setups, increase workers and set MACHINE_LEARNING_DEVICE_IDS (e.g. 0,1) to distribute workers across GPUs.

Config.Name: MACHINE_LEARNING_WORKER_TIMEOUT
Config.Description: Seconds before a worker is considered unresponsive. GPU inference can be slow on first run.

Config.Name: IMMICH_LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Log verbosity: verbose, debug, log, warn, error
